environment.tool: scripts/probes/rce/row.py sweep 2026-11-18 (control-first, exact request bytes, executing peer)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET //x?a%0d%0aGET%20/exec%3fcmd=id%0d%0aHost:%20u%0d%0a%20HTTP/1.1 HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `ae021893:51` (decode rejects only NUL/backslash and `c<32`).
findings.title: request_line_split: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['POST //x HTTP/1.1', 'GET //exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `ae021893:64` (`upstream`, body appended but length not re-framed).
findings.title: body_replay_desync: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET /%2fexec%20?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `ae021893:67` (`cachekey`), `:69` (`lookup`), `:70` (`storecache`).
findings.title: cache_exec_poison: verified upstream-side RCE (critical)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['POST //x HTTP/1.1', 'GET //exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `ae021893:64` (1xx accepted as terminal, `status>=100&&status<200` sets `len=0`).
findings.title: 1xx_nesting: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

limitations: Covers the eight request-smuggling RCE families of the rce_matrix; static-only findings from the earlier audits are recorded in their own envelopes.
methods: row.py cell harness with benign control, fresh peer and proxy per cell, exact bytes from cells.json

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
provenance.release_metadata: historical release.json omitted the tag field; tag resolved from the existing Git tag and verified against the submitted source
verified: release tag resolves to the submitted source
source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes

scope: Empirical RCE verification of the tagged release: every positive cell of the rce_matrix driven with real request bytes; a cell passes only on an upstream-side effect.
